name: stats-guy-fantasy
description: Fantasy football player and rookie pick values, rankings, and trade evaluation from Stats Guy Fantasy.

interface.longDescription:
Stats Guy Fantasy values every fantasy football player and rookie draft pick from real trades made in thousands of leagues, recalculated daily. Ask whether a trade is fair, see rankings, or look up a player or pick.

What you can do:
- Evaluate a trade: list what each side gives up (players and rookie picks such as "2027 1st" or "2026 1.03") and get each asset's value, side totals, and whether the trade is even.
- Rankings: current overall or positional rankings for a format.
- Player lookups: a player's value, overall and position rank, and value change over the last 7 and 30 days, in every format.
- Rookie pick values: early, mid, and late picks by round, and exact slots once a draft order is set.

Formats: superflex (2QB) and 1QB, dynasty and redraft. TE-premium leagues are supported with standard, TE-premium, and big TE-premium tiers, and dynasty IDP leagues can be priced by number of IDP starters and scoring style. Tell the assistant your league settings for the most accurate values.

For dynasty and redraft fantasy football managers deciding on trades and tracking player values.

Good to know: Values reflect the trade market, not weekly projections. Read-only and no account needed.
defaultPrompt: Is Brock Bowers for Bijan Robinson a fair trade in my superflex dynasty league?
Who are the top 10 dynasty running backs in 1QB leagues?
What is a 2027 mid first-round rookie pick worth in superflex dynasty?

positive.description: Evaluate a two-player trade in a stated format
positive.prompt: In my superflex dynasty league, is Brock Bowers for Bijan Robinson a fair trade?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls evaluate_trade with format sf_dynasty. Reports each player's Stats Guy Fantasy value, the side totals, and which side gets more value or that the trade is roughly even. Values match https://statsguyfantasy.com/trade for the same players and format.

positive.description: Evaluate a trade with a draft pick in a TE-premium league
positive.prompt: My league is superflex dynasty with 0.5 extra PPR for tight ends. Would you trade Bijan Robinson for Trey McBride and a 2027 1st?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls evaluate_trade with format sf_dynasty and tep set to tep. Prices the 2027 first-round pick and Trey McBride at the TE-premium value, gives side totals, and says which side gets more value or that it is roughly even.

positive.prompt: Who are the top 10 dynasty wide receivers in 1QB leagues?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_rankings with format non_sf_dynasty, position WR, and limit 10. Lists ten wide receivers in rank order with their values, matching https://statsguyfantasy.com/rankings for 1QB dynasty WRs.

positive.prompt: How has Marvin Harrison Jr.'s dynasty value changed over the last month?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_player, resolving the name to the wide receiver. Reports his current value and rank and his value change over the last 7 and 30 days, and names the format it used or gives superflex and 1QB values.

positive.prompt: What are 2027 rookie draft picks worth in superflex dynasty?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_pick_values with format sf_dynasty and year 2027. Lists early, mid, and late values for each round, highest first.

negative.description: The plugin cannot access a user's fantasy league. The assistant should say it can't pull league rosters through Stats Guy Fantasy rather than inventing a league or rosters.
negative.prompt: Pull up my Sleeper league's rosters and tell me which team is strongest.

negative.description: Kickers are not covered. The assistant should say Stats Guy Fantasy does not value kickers rather than inventing a value or returning another player's value.
negative.prompt: What is Justin Tucker worth in my dynasty league?

negative.description: The plugin is read-only and cannot act in a user's fantasy league. The assistant should explain it cannot send trade offers.
negative.prompt: Send a trade offer for Bijan Robinson to my leaguemate on Sleeper.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Trade evaluation, rankings, player lookups, and rookie pick values for superflex and 1QB dynasty and redraft formats, with TE-premium tiers and defenders for dynasty IDP leagues.
